title: acs ship workflow (workflows/ship.yaml)
description: The declarative pipeline /acs:ship drives: an ordered list of steps, each naming a build/test/ship skill (workflows/phases.yaml is the registry; merge-pr and release are never steps), what it needs, and the predicates that skip (`when`) or block (`requires`) it. A consumer override at <repo>/.acs/workflows/ship.yaml replaces the plugin default wholesale. Semantic checks beyond this schema — unique ids, `needs` naming EARLIER steps, `stop_after` existing, predicate names known, an acyclic DAG — live in acs_lib.workflow.validate_workflow.

stop_after.description: The step whose completion ends the run; must be a step id.

max_parallel.description: How many READY steps `workflow next` may hand back at once in `parallel` mode.

skill.description: phases.yaml build + test + ship skills, minus merge-pr and release (acs_lib.workflow.allowed_ship_skills).

needs.description: Ids of EARLIER steps that must be satisfied (completed, or skipped by a false `when`) first.

when.description: Skip the step (recorded as `skipped`) when this predicate is false.

requires.description: Block the step (reported as `blocked_by` with a pointer) while this predicate is false.

args.description: The skill's argument string; `{ticket_id}` is substituted.

exclusive.description: Run alone: never in a parallel batch.
